Title: Azure Red Hat OpenShift virtual network peering and ExpressRoute support

Body.Content:
Virtual network peering and ExpressRoute support in Azure Red Hat OpenShift is now available in preview. This means that, for clusters deployed in East US 2, it’s now possible to peer your virtual networks with your cluster's virtual network for on-premises connectivity. With this release, connecting the cluster's virtual network to an ExpressRoute circuit is also possible. Support for additional regions will be added soon.

Learn more
